android_mechanism: Every scanned port enqueues UI work without throttling; fix moves/throttles the work
bug_description: The search input's onChange handler fires a network search request to the backend for every single keystroke with no debounce or cancellation. Typing a 10-character query issues 10 requests, most of which are obsolete by the time they return; their responses race and each response re-assigns the result state, re-rendering the result list repeatedly and wasting radio/CPU and UI-thread time.
fix_summary: Search-as-you-type is debounced by 300ms (timer reset on each keystroke, cleared on submit), so one request is issued per paused query instead of one per keystroke.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.note: unfixed issues ~11 requests per typed query vs 1-2 fixed; each extra request costs serialise+send+parse+render instructions

mechanism_oracle.definition: Count of outbound HTTP search requests observed in the network trace while typing one 10-character query (plus submit).
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed: ~11 requests per typed query (one per keystroke + submit); fixed: 1-2 requests. Corresponding CPU/radio activity and result-list re-renders drop proportionally.

reproduction: git -C hosts/ytmusic checkout case/ytmusic_search_no_debounce/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/ytmusic checkout case/ytmusic_search_no_debounce/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
